links.outcome: Readability of LLM cardiac rehabilitation education responses (Gunning Fog, Flesch-Kincaid, Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Mean readability scores did not meet US grade reading level recommendations for ChatGPT 3.5, Copilot, and Gemini; Gemini and Copilot were easier to read than ChatGPT 3.5.
links.quote: The findings of this study demonstrate that the mean Gunning Fog, Flesch Kincaid, and Flesch Reading Ease scores do not meet US grade reading level recommendations across three models: ChatGPT 3.5, Copilot, and Gemini.

screen.reason: Evaluated the readability of cardiovascular rehabilitation educational responses generated by three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT 3.5, Copilot, Gemini) using automated readability metrics.
